versions.changelog:
Initial release of 1688-bp-inquiry-evaluate.

- Provides quality evaluation and improvement suggestions for 1688 shop staff/customer service team.
- Supports team-level summary and individual staff inquiry diagnosis functions.
- Strictly displays only real data obtained by CLI commands; prohibits fabrication of summaries, ratings, or user IDs.
- Automatically enforces time range limitation (no queries beyond 31 days; opens full evaluation page if exceeded).
- Includes robust parameter prompting for missing dates or staff IDs.
- All outputs are either original CLI returns or specific fallback messages; no output modifications.
- Requires ALI_1688_AK environment variable, with clear user guidance for authentication issues.
- Automatic skill usage tracking for every CLI command executed.
